name: Myoujin Sumika
source:
She is the proprietress of the Myojin Ryokan, a long-established ryokan that will be the site of the company's partnership.

Since her husband passed away, she has been running the inn by herself. However, she seems to be lonely sleeping alone as a woman in her prime...?

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/5580]official site[/url]]
